name: Inter-Packet Network Arrival Jitter at Nanosecond Resolution
description: High-speed network telemetry measures packet arrival jitter (variance in inter-packet delay). Jitter spikes indicate network congestion or buffer bloat.
prompt:
High-speed network telemetry measures packet arrival jitter (variance in inter-packet delay). Jitter spikes indicate network congestion or buffer bloat.

Execute the required analytical SQL calculation in DuckDB.
Expected output columns: packet_id, captured_at, delta_microseconds, rolling_jitter_stddev.
Results should be ordered as specified.
golden_sql:
-- Compute inter-packet arrival delta in microseconds and identify variance
            WITH deltas AS (
                SELECT 
                    packet_id,
                    captured_at,
                    date_diff('microsecond', 
                        LAG(captured_at) OVER (ORDER BY captured_at), 
                        captured_at
                    ) AS delta_microseconds
                FROM packet_stream
            )
            SELECT 
                packet_id,
                captured_at,
                delta_microseconds,
                -- Measure moving jitter variance over last 3 packets
                ROUND(STDDEV(delta_microseconds) OVER (
                    ORDER BY captured_at 
                    ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
                ), 2) AS rolling_jitter_stddev
            FROM deltas
            ORDER BY captured_at;
why_it_fails: Standard SQL datetime arithmetic truncates to milliseconds or seconds, losing high-frequency microsecond microbursts.
